subject: UNIFIEDDB_PULSE_EFFECTIVIZER_S2_CONTENT_ABA_VS_VERSIONED_PROJECTION_IDENTITY

baseline_evidence.relevant_semantics: SPM-S1 test fixtures intentionally advance target_record_id versions (for example rec:<seed>:...:v0 to v1/v2) and segment hashes commit to target_record_id as well as target_logical_id/path data. Therefore equal final content fingerprint does not prove equal projection identity.

hypothesis_under_test: A per-logical A->B->A content-fingerprint chain may be removed entirely from final-state projection work because its final content fingerprint equals its entry fingerprint.
strongest_counterhypothesis: The same-content return can still carry a new record/version/provenance identity; dropping the touched logical id and its impacted seeds can reuse an ABA-stale immutable access segment even though the final global source epoch advances.

events: A: content a0 -> a1, record version 0 -> 1, impact seed:A
A: content a1 -> a0, record version 1 -> 2, impact seed:A
B: content b0 -> b1, record version 0 -> 1, impact seed:B

root_cause: S2 currently treats before_fingerprint == after_fingerprint as permission to erase both the logical invalidation identity and its impact seeds. That is only content equality. SPM-S1 projection identity can include versioned target_record_id/provenance, so content cancellation is not automatically identity cancellation.

minimal_conservative_candidate.rule: Keep net-zero chains in cancelled_logical_ids for content diagnostics, but preserve every touched logical id and union every event impact seed into the one final SPM invalidation plan unless a future explicit identity-stability witness proves safe erasure.
minimal_conservative_candidate.fully_cancelled_batch_effect: No metadata-only fake change is needed: the touched logical id remains a real invalidation identity; SPM can recompute its seeds against the final source state and publish the new epoch even when the resulting immutable segment is reusable.
minimal_conservative_candidate.rollback: Disable batch effectivization and execute existing sequential SPM-S1.

bounded_proxy_tradeoff.fixture: same 5000-seed/200-logical/200-event/batch-size-10 rng-seed-7 workload used by the S2 receipt
bounded_proxy_tradeoff.interpretation: Identity-safe recomputation gives up only 3.375 percentage points of the synthetic recompute reduction while preserving the dominant 90% generation-map publication reduction. The previous 10.198x p50 proxy speedup must be rerun; it is not assumed unchanged.

architecture_delta.new_test_obligation: Every effectivization cancellation claim must distinguish content fingerprint equality from record/version/provenance identity stability and compare batched final projection against an independent sequential/full rebuild on versioned-record fixtures.

out_of_box: No additional out-of-box experiment counted here; this is a normal cross-branch falsifier. The exact-go macrocycle already consumed its one allowed unusual experiment in the WP03 conflict-peeling lane.
